items.text: Instead of using aggressive last-minute discounts, which you should only consider for events like Cyber Monday or Black Friday, offer a larger trial to ensure you stay compliant and safe.
Ideally default to a yearly product because it has the highest lifetime value.
Only show two pricing options to decrease cognitive load on the user.
If you want to support other pricing options, always hide them behind a view all plans button that opens up a sheet with all the different pricing.
Keep the base paywall simple and get a bunch of users in there to see how your base stats perform before you start optimizing all your different placements.
Test every copy, the pricing, and the flow until something clearly wins.
